'''Weapons blisters''' were a part of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]]. They were the same size and shape as [[passenger blister]]s, and many cruisers belonging to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had their passenger blisters replaced with weapons blisters.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
